title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.
 We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.
 What You'll Do Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.
 Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour. Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment. Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers. Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements. What You Bring Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures. Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain. Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing. Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it. Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain…

title: Working Student (m/f/d) -  Data Engineer & Software Developer (Research Analytics)
description:
About the Role
 
Join us as a working student and help build an internal data platform for analyzing scientific publications in robotics and AI research. The platform brings together openly available information about publications and turns it into a clear, reliable picture of how the research field is developing.
Your work will give our team a solid data foundation for understanding research trends, emerging topics, and where new momentum is building. You will design and develop software tools that collect, validate, store and visualize this information, and you will see your work used by colleagues in their daily work.
 
What You Will Do
 
Build and maintain an internal research data platform
  • Design, implement and maintain an internal application for collecting, processing, validating, storing and visualizing publication data
  • Develop components for automated data acquisition from open sources such as scholarly APIs, repositories and websites
  • Implement backend services and data pipelines for reliable processing and integration
  • Contribute to frontend components for accessing, managing and exploring the data
  • Use AI-assisted development practices to build and extend the platform efficiently
Ensure data quality and automation
  • Implement automated and AI-supported validation, cleaning and quality assurance for the collected data

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer (Modelling & Transformation)| Hybrid Working | Hatfield

Introduction:

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role:

As a Data Engineer within our Data Engineering Modelling and Transformation team, you will be directly responsible for building and maintaining the foundational data warehouse that powers analytics, reporting, machine learning, and partner data products across Ocado Technology. In this role, you will transform raw operational data into trusted, governed, and business-ready datasets that drive strategic and operational decision-making across the entire organisation.

Working in an agile environment, you will collaborate closely with data scientists, analysts, product owners, and platform engineers to deliver high-quality data feeds and scalable transformation frameworks
